node.statement: By the lemma's hypothesis on top-row fiber masses, the display row's fiber-aggregated masses are exactly the pinned values: c^{(v)}_v = c_v = 1 - tau, c^{(v)}_w = c_w = tau + t, c^{(v)}_f = c_f = -t, and c^{(v)}_Q = 0 for every other full row-point fiber Q.
